text: Flags the bare except Exception that logs a generic 'Skipped row' with no detail — silently swallows parse errors, key errors, and data corruption without recording which row failed or why
Flags handle_data as a shallow name that describes mechanics rather than intent — something like import_transactions_from_csv would convey the domain operation
Flags the table name 'items' as generic — the domain concept is transactions, not items
Flags the magic threshold numbers 10000 and 1000 for categorization — unexplained business rules baked into code with no documentation or named constants
Flags that a partial import leaves committed rows in the database with no rollback — if the process dies mid-file, there is no way to know what was imported
